class.name: SpacetimeDBTable
class.brief_description: A client-side cache of a SpacetimeDB database table.
class.description: SpacetimeDBTable stores the local copy of rows for a single SpacetimeDB table. Rows are kept in sync automatically when subscribed through [SpacetimeDBClient]. Each row is represented as a [Dictionary] with column names as keys. Signals are emitted when rows are inserted, deleted, or updated.

method.name: add_column
method.description: Adds a column definition. [param type] is one of: "bool", "u8", "i8", "u16", "i16", "u32", "i32", "u64", "i64", "f32", "f64", "string", "bytes", "identity", "connection_id".

method.name: insert_row
method.description: Inserts a row into the local cache and emits [signal row_inserted].

method.name: delete_row
method.description: Removes a matching row from the local cache and emits [signal row_deleted].

method.name: get_rows
method.description: Returns all rows currently in the cache as an Array of Dictionaries.

method.name: get_row_count
method.description: Returns the number of rows in the cache.

method.name: find_by_primary_key
method.description: Finds and returns a row by its primary key value, or an empty Dictionary if not found.

method.name: decode_row_bsatn
method.description: Decodes a single BSATN-encoded row from [param data] starting at [param offset], using the table's column schema.

members.member: The column name used as the primary key for row lookups.

signal.name: row_inserted
signal.description: Emitted when a row is inserted.

signal.name: row_deleted
signal.description: Emitted when a row is deleted.

signal.name: row_updated
signal.description: Emitted when a row is updated.
